breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a preamble with contradictory instructions on how to interpret Nx and dx. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect, contradictory sentence. The agent resolved this by removing the entire ambiguous preamble and directly stating the correct, specific grid definition required for the task, which aligns perfectly with the unambiguous instructions in the ground truth.
